misprints.note: Print has a circumflex on the upsilon in 'ᾗ ἂν τάξῃ ὁ δαίμων, ταῦτῃ πορεύεσθαι'.
The relative pronoun is printed with a rough breathing and no grave accent.

uncertain.note: At the right edge of the line 'ἐφ' shows no apostrophe. It may be cropped or may never have printed. I kept the elision mark.
The article is damaged type that looks like a bare 'η' with no clear breathing. I read it as ἡ.
A stray vertical mark after the opening parenthesis looks like a printing artefact. I left it out.
